body:
## Context
1. Issues #868 & #858: `plugins/adlc-herdr/herdr-plugin.toml` is a version-bearing host plugin manifest stranded at `version = "0.2.0"` because `scripts/release.mjs` only discovers JSON manifests (`plugin.json` / `marketplace.json`).
2. Issue #869: The `verify` block in `.claude/release-profile.md` exits 0 with no output when package enumeration produces an empty `names` list.

## Changes
1. Update `plugins/adlc-herdr/herdr-plugin.toml` to the current suite version (`1.12.0`) and update `plugins/adlc-herdr/README.md` if it hardcodes `(v0.2.0)`.
2. Extend `scripts/release.mjs` to discover, preflight-check, bump, and drift-check `herdr-plugin.toml` under `plugins/*` alongside JSON host manifests, and add tests in `scripts/test/release.test.mjs` (including a real-repo `findVersionDrift` lockstep test).
3. Harden the `verify` block in `.claude/release-profile.md` to count enumerated targets, exit 1 if the count is 0, and print the verified target count on completion, with a test in `scripts/test/release.test.mjs`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `scripts/release.mjs` bumps `herdr-plugin.toml` and `findVersionDrift` reports drift when `herdr-plugin.toml` disagrees with the suite version (and returns `[]` against the real repo tree at the current root version). Verify: `node --test scripts/test/release.test.mjs scripts/test/release-artifact.test.mjs plugins/adlc-herdr/test/manifest.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC2: `.claude/release-profile.md` `verify` block fails closed (`exit 1`) when 0 targets are enumerated. Verify: `node --test scripts/test/release.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: fix(release): bump and drift-check herdr-plugin.toml and guard release-profile verify denominator (#868, #858, #869)
